name: GEMMA
full_name: Germanium Experiment for measurement of the Magnetic Moment of Antineutrino
summary: GEMMA searched for an anomalous magnetic moment of reactor electron antineutrinos with a low-background germanium spectrometer at Kalinin. A magnetic contribution would enhance the low-energy electron-recoil spectrum over the weak-interaction expectation.
detection_principle: A high-purity germanium crystal measures electron-recoil ionization. Active sodium-iodide shielding and passive copper, polyethylene and lead reduce backgrounds. Reactor-on/off comparison constrains an additional low-energy scattering component.

key_parameters.value: Less than 2.9 × 10^-11 Bohr magnetons at 90% confidence

results.summary: No magnetic scattering excess was established. Upgrade sensitivities in the same paper are projections and are not achieved GEMMA limits.
